title: CPU-vs-GPU byte-identity regression for DVB-T2 chain
description:
## Goal

Regression test asserting byte-identity of the deterministic
columns across {CPU-only, CPU-parallel-24-thread, CPU+GPU}
executions at the same seed for all six in-scope DVB-T2 MODCODs.
**Four-column** byte-identity for the CPU-only vs CPU-parallel
comparison; **three-column** byte-identity (excluding
`mean_iters`) for the CPU-vs-GPU comparison per `ec530af9` §11.
Lands the CLAUDE.md amendments that close Story `5d0a3fad`
(Phase D).

## Context

Task under story `5d0a3fad` (DVB-T2 BICM application) within epic
`gf2-sim` (`f9717e7e`). Phase 0 design doc:
`dev/active/ec530af9-pipeline-design.md` §11 (determinism contract
with CPU-vs-GPU relaxation). Wave D.3: depends on `bbf6b6ee`. This
is the Phase D closing task that lands the CLAUDE.md amendments
per Q5 decision.

## Deliverables

1. `crates/gf2-sim/tests/dvb_t2_regression.rs`:
   - For each of the six DVB-T2 MODCODs (3 rates × 2 modulations):
     - Run 50 frames at a fixed seed and a fixed Es/N0 near the
       smoke-knee from `dev/benchmarks/dvb_t2_awgn/smoke/`
       (amended from 200 — see AMENDMENT 2026-06-12 below; a
       one-time 200-frame off-test run per MODCOD is recorded in
       receipts as completion evidence).
     - Mode A: `Pipeline::dvb_t2()...parallelism(1).build()` (CPU-only).
     - Mode B: `Pipeline::dvb_t2()...parallelism(24).build()`
       (CPU-parallel).
     - Mode C: `Pipeline::dvb_t2()...with_gpu(true).build()` (CPU+GPU);
       only compiled under `#[cfg(feature = "hip")]`.
     - **Assert byte-identity of `fer / frames / errors /
       mean_iters` between A and B** (four columns; CPU paths
       only).
     - **Assert byte-identity of `fer / frames / errors` between
       A and C** (three columns; `mean_iters` excluded for the GPU
       comparison per `ec530af9` §11, user-approved Q3
       2026-06-07).
     - **Log** `mean_iters` for C and the diff vs A; do not assert.
2. The GPU half of the regression (mode C and the A-vs-C
   assertions) is `#[cfg(feature = "hip")]`-gated so the default
   CI matrix passes without HIP. The gfx1030 CI job runs the GPU
   half. Resolves audit finding M5.
3. CLAUDE.md amendments (Phase D close):
   - Update the DVB-T2 BICM AWGN campaign section to reference the
     new `gf2-sim`-backed binary path (the legacy
     `SimulationRunner::run_with_decoder` reference remains for
     historical context).
   - Mark `dev/benchmarks/dvb_t2_awgn/` legacy with forward-pointer
     to `dev/benchmarks/gf2-sim/`.
   - Document the determinism contract verbatim from `ec530af9`
     §11, **including the CPU-vs-GPU `mean_iters` exclusion**.
4. Receipts:
   - Update `dev/benchmarks/dvb_t2_awgn/PLAN.md` with a closing
     note pointing forward to the new pipeline and to
     `dev/benchmarks/gf2-sim/cpu-foundation-receipts.md` for the
     parallel throughput numbers (per project plan §11).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] Regression test asserts byte-identity of `fer / frames /
  errors / mean_iters` between Mode A (CPU-only) and Mode B
  (CPU-parallel-24-thread) at the same seed for all six DVB-T2
  MODCODs.
- [hard] Regression test asserts byte-identity of `fer / frames /
  errors` (three columns) between Mode A (CPU-only) and Mode C
  (CPU+GPU on gfx1030) at the same seed for all six DVB-T2
  MODCODs. `mean_iters` is logged but NOT asserted for the GPU
  comparison.
- [hard] GPU half of the regression is `#[cfg(feature = "hip")]`-
  gated; default CI passes without HIP.
- [hard] CLAUDE.md updated with the three items above (legacy
  forward-pointer + new binary path reference + determinism
  contract with the `mean_iters` exclusion).
- [hard] `dev/benchmarks/dvb_t2_awgn/PLAN.md` has the closing
  forward-pointer note.
- [hard] `cargo-ci`, `code-review`, `tests` gates green.

## Non-goals

- BER inclusion in byte-identity (excluded per status-quo).
- `mean_iters` inclusion in CPU-vs-GPU byte-identity (excluded per
  `ec530af9` §11, user-approved Q3 2026-06-07).
- Production sweep with ≥ 100 errors at bracket points (owned by
  `e4849f07`).

## AMENDMENT 2026-06-12 (user-approved): 50-frame slow legs

Deliverable-1's frame count is amended 200 → 50 for the in-test
slow legs. Empirical basis (lead pre-dispatch measurement at HEAD
ac6c72d6, quiet host, `parallel_throughput --workers 1,24
--frames 200 --es-n0 6.0`, r1/2 16-QAM SumProduct/ExactLogMap at
the calibrated 6.0 dB waterfall): Mode A (CPU-only,
parallelism=1) runs at 1.1801 fps → the 200-frame A-arm alone is
~170 s, busting the 120 s slow-tier per-test cap (mean_iters
≈ 47.78 — BP near its 50-iteration cap in the waterfall regime;
Mode B at 24 workers is 11.17 fps ≈ 18 s, unaffected). 50-frame
legs fit (~42 s A-arm) and remain non-vacuous at the calibrated
waterfall points (D.1 precedent: 12–21/50 errored). Mirrors the
user-approved 8c8302c8 AMENDMENT 2026-06-11 (same wall, same
resolution). A one-time 200-frame off-test run per MODCOD MUST be
recorded in `dev/benchmarks/gf2-sim/` receipts as completion
evidence for the original 200-frame intent (off-test, so the cap
does not apply). The success criteria (which name no frame count)
are unchanged.
